description:
Baraza.Pdf.Helper ================= Baraza.Pdf.Helper is a lightweight, enterprise-ready .NET library for converting HTML content into PDF documents. It provides a simple, reliable API to generate PDFs from HTML strings or templates, with built-in error handling and concurrency safety. Perfect for web applications, APIs, or backend services that require dynamic PDF generation without heavy dependencies or complex configuration. Key Features ------------ ✅ Convert raw HTML strings to high-quality PDFs (A4 format) ✅ Automatic handling of invalid or malformed HTML with fallback error PDF ✅ Enterprise-grade concurrency control for safe multi-threaded usage ✅ Single browser instance lifecycle for high-performance PDF rendering ✅ Fully asynchronous API leveraging Microsoft Playwright ✅ Compatible with .NET 6, 7, 8 ✅ Easy integration into any .NET application via NuGet Usage Example ------------- using Baraza.Pdf.Helper.Service.Service.HtmlToPdf; // Option 1: Direct instantiation IHtmlToPdfService pdfService = new HtmlToPdfService(); string htmlContent = "

Hello World

"; // Generate PDF bytes byte[] pdfBytes = await pdfService.ConvertHtmlToPdfAsync(htmlContent); // Save to disk await File.WriteAllBytesAsync("output.pdf", pdfBytes); Note: If HTML is malformed or cannot be rendered, the library will generate a default error PDF instead of throwing unhandled exceptions. Installation ------------ 1️⃣ Install the NuGet Package dotnet add package Baraza.Pdf.Helper --version 1.0.0 2️⃣ Install Microsoft Playwright CLI Playwright requires a headless browser for rendering: dotnet tool install --global Microsoft.Playwright.CLI 3️⃣ Install or Update Playwright Browsers playwright install # Install browsers playwright install --force # Update browsers if needed 4️⃣ Verify Playwright Installation playwright --version Note: - Your project must reference Baraza.Pdf.Helper and include the Microsoft.Playwright NuGet package. - On first run, the library automatically detects installed Playwright browser executables. - For server environments, ensure the process has permission to access the Playwright browser paths (or set a custom path if needed). Dependency Injection (ASP.NET Core) ----------------------------------- builder.Services.AddScoped(); > Press Ctrl + . in Visual Studio to add the namespace if needed. Target Audience --------------- Developers building .NET applications that require dynamic PDF generation from HTML templates or content, with enterprise-grade reliability and minimal setup. Support / Contact ----------------- For issues or contributions, visit the GitHub repository or contact the author directly.
